name: farm-v1
contract: The page must expose window.game.state() returning { player: {x, y}, tiles: { 'x,y': { crop, stage } }, inventory: { seeds, crops }, day }. Keys: arrows move one tile; p plants a seed on the player's tile; t advances time by one tick; h harvests a grown crop on the player's tile; s saves to localStorage; the saved game is restored on load.

steps.name: loads with no page or console errors and exposes state
p plants a seed on the player's tile and spends a seed
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; return !!state.tiles[k] && !(before.tiles || {})[k] && state.inventory.seeds === before.inventory.seeds - 1; })()

steps.name: t advances time and the crop grows
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; return !!state.tiles[k] && state.tiles[k].stage > before.tiles[k].stage; })()

steps.name: h harvests the grown crop into the inventory
steps.expect: (function(){ const k = state.player.x + ',' + state.player.y; return state.inventory.crops === before.inventory.crops + 1 && !state.tiles[k]; })()

steps.name: s saves and the game is restored after a reload
steps.expect: Object.keys(storage).length > 0 && state.inventory.crops === before.inventory.crops && state.inventory.crops > 0 && state.player.x === before.player.x && state.player.y === before.player.y && state.day === before.day

steps.name: still no errors after the whole play
